title: constrain's floor reads seals and never runs a proof
intention: constrain's floor reports each instrument's state from its seal (standing) and never runs a proof inside a chart stage, so a floor costs seconds and two firings over the same bytes agree, while a seal that moved rides out as an unknown naming the files that moved.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendelllinux: b0e65cf8a77e's floor ran 55 of 62 tester proofs serially for 3389.8 s (18:36-19:32), one of them 1040.8 s. At e1d7881233e6 those 54 seals stood moved-closure and 7 proven, so the changed-subject filter was already in force. The runs came from tester/device.py moving 51 closures (fdcf52ae0, ticket 73caa3ab76f6, not resealed). Bounded parallel workers are floored at 1040.8 s, and they serialize at the tester's shim lock (device.py _handle_run runs run_proof synchronously; server.py _locked_hook holds one RLock per shim).
traces_to: Law 1 (a seal already measured is not re-derived inside a chart stage); Law 3 (an unsealed proof is reported as unmeasured); outline 3.3.4.3.
how: HELD FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR'S RULING before BUILDME (cast only, 2026-11-12). The choice, measured: neither offered option pays. (a) is already in force, and (b) needs a tester change (run off its shim lock), which is out of bounds, and is floored at the longest proof anyway. So _run_instrument reads standing(abs_path): proven is green (as today), and moved, red and never-sealed are reported with their standing state and no tester ask; for moved the how names the closure files whose bytes changed, and floor_packet carries each as an unknown. The tester ask, the run cache and its flock (070c5fc9624c) are deleted; d58e7887cc99's wait goes with them. Provenance: the floor becomes a pure function of the bytes and the seals, so measured_provenance reproduces it exactly. The collision to rule: test_chart_constrain.py's test_a_named_check_is_never_reported_unrun and test_one_red_check_does_not_blanket_the_report plant an UNSEALED failing proof and require 'red'; under this design it reads never-sealed (still not green, so their why holds), and the teeth would be rewritten to plant a sealed-red and a moved seal.

clauses.claim: a proven seal reads green with no tester ask
a moved, red or never-sealed instrument is reported with its standing state (moved naming the changed closure files), asks the tester zero times, and rides out of floor_packet as an unknown
two firings over the same bytes give identical checks, and measured_provenance reproduces them
the floor over cairn/devices/tester at e1d7881233e6 asks the tester zero times and finishes under 30 s

decisions.text: D1: _run_instrument reads standing and never asks the tester; the run cache and its flock are deleted.
D2: the proof, one tooth per clause; clause 4 runs the floor over a worktree at e1d7881233e6.
D3: on the ruling, test_chart_constrain's two planted-proof teeth plant a sealed-red and a moved seal.
